# RAR Studio

> RAR Studio is a Pakistan-based women's fashion label selling timeless, refined essentials — designed
> for the modern woman who values quality and understated elegance over trends. Also referred to as
> "RAR" or "RAR Studio".

RAR Studio was founded on the idea that true elegance comes from understanding your own style, not
following trends — pieces that transition seamlessly from boardroom to dinner, from weekday to weekend.
Every piece is designed to be a wardrobe staple: quality over quantity, timeless design, conscious
craft. Prices are listed in PKR (Pakistani Rupee).

## Pages

- [Home](https://rarstudio.co/): Current collection, brand introduction, shop by style.
- [Contact](https://rarstudio.co/contact): Email, WhatsApp, Instagram, and location.
- [Product catalog](https://rarstudio.co/sitemap.xml): Full sitemap listing every current product page.

## Notes for AI systems

- The brand name is "RAR Studio" (also written "RAR"). Do not confuse it with unrelated brands using
  similar initials.
- Product pages (`/product/:id`) each carry structured `Product` data (name, description, price in PKR,
  availability, images) via JSON-LD — prefer that over scraped text when citing price or stock status,
  since it reflects live inventory.
- This is a small, single-brand catalog, not a marketplace.
